column1: # comment: "Location alignments for comprehensive geo interop \u2014 schema.org, GeoSPARQL, GeoNames, Getty (gvp), Wikidata, WGS84, vCard, BOT, ifcOWL, IVOA, UAT, SWEET, IEEE 1872-2015 CORA, KnowRob, SOMA, FALDO, Sequence Ontology. placeType/storageMedium/celestialObjectType/sequenceFeatureType are value individuals aligned (closeMatch) to external classes/feature-codes; address components align to schema.org + vCard for lossless round-trip; containedInPlace aligns to the topological \"within\"/parent relations of every geo vocab. StorageLocation/Location/storage* and authorityLink are canonical (no faithful external term). Coreference of place INSTANCES to gazetteer records is done in data with skos:exactMatch + gmeow:authorityLink (Wikidata as hub), not here. Added (stream-to-trajectory design): Stream \u2192 sta:Datastream; LocationState \u2192 sta:HistoricalLocation + sosa:Sample; Trajectory \u2192 sta:Datastream. Added: indoor realm bridging to BOT (Zone/Site/Building/Storey/Space, containsZone, adjacentZone) and ifcOWL (IfcBuilding/IfcBuildingStorey/IfcSpace/IfcSite) by reference. Added (celestial-frame design): CelestialLocation / CelestialCoordinates bridging to IVOA refframe/refposition/object-type, UAT, and SWEET. IVOA timescale alignments live in temporal.ttl. Added (robotic-frame design): Robotic realm bridging to IEEE 1872-2015 CORA (Robot, RoboticSystem), KnowRob (SemanticEnvironmentMap, RobotBaseTrajectory, Joint, FrameOfReference), and SOMA (ArtificialAgent). Added (biological-sequence design): Biological-sequence realm bridging to FALDO (Region, begin, end, ForwardStrandPosition, ReverseStrandPosition, reference), Sequence Ontology (sequence_feature, gene, exon, intron, CDS, SNP, chromosome), and Wikidata (GRCh38, genomic location, sense/antisense strand). Added (geocoding design): Geocode and geocoding ReferenceFrames (Plus Code, what3words, geohash, MGRS, UN/LOCODE, mile-marker) aligned to Wikidata QIDs. Added (spatial-measurement design): SpatialMeasurement / CoordinateObservation bridging to GeoSPARQL geo:Feature and schema.org GeoCoordinates. Added (cadastral design): Cadastral / land-administration realm bridging to ISO 19152 LADM (LA_SpatialUnit, LA_RRR, LA_Party, LA_BoundaryFace) and INSPIRE Cadastral Parcels (CadastralParcel, CadastralBoundary, CadastralZoning, BasicPropertyUnit, nationalCadastralReference) by reference. Added (vertical/maritime/aviation-zone design): Maritime / aviation zones aligned to MRGID ontology (direct), AIXM / UNCLOS / IHO S-100 via Wikidata hub; vertical-dimension reference frames (altitude MSL, flight level, AGL, depth MSL, chart datum)."

GMEOW Agent is broader (any entity capable of action), but within the land-administration context it aligns to LADM LA_Party (a person or organisation with rights).
GMEOW CadastralReference is the reified structured identifier; INSPIRE nationalCadastralReference is the property carrying the identifier. Close structural match.
Brick Capacity is a class for the max number of entities a space can hold; GMEOW Capacity is a reified Measurement with location, scalar result, and provenance.

column7: Wikidata P131 is the flat administrative-hierarchy property; GMEOW ContainmentTenure reifies it with temporal scope and standpoint indexing.
GeoSPARQL Feature is a spatial thing with a geometry; GMEOW CoordinateObservation is the act of assigning that geometry. Related match only.
Wikidata Q283821 is the general concept of a geocode; GMEOW Geocode is the upper-ontology-grounded class with frame-relativity (P11).
GMEOW Geometry is the general geometric construct; INSPIRE CadastralBoundary is a specific geometry type representing a parcel boundary.
GMEOW Geometry is the general geometric construct; LADM LA_BoundaryFace is a specific 2D boundary face element.
CIDOC-CRM E4_Period captures the time-spanned governance period; GMEOW JurisdictionTenure adds the place×polity relator structure and standpoint indexing.
INSPIRE BasicPropertyUnit represents a unit of property with homogeneous rights; GMEOW LandTenure is the time-scoped rights relationship itself. Related but not identical scope.

GMEOW LandTenure bridges Place × Agent × RightsStatement, while LADM LA_RRR covers rights, restrictions, and responsibilities over a spatial unit. Close semantic match but different structural decomposition.
CIDOC-CRM E92 Spacetime Volume — a 4D point set; GMEOW LocationState is a discrete slice (location + time + pose) of it
CRMgeo SP1 Spacetime Volume — the geospatial extension of CIDOC E92
A LocationState in a stream is a sample of the entity's trajectory.
HistoricalLocation is time-indexed location of a Thing; LocationState is the state of a moving entity at a time.
Wikidata Q11135 is the general IP address concept; GMEOW NetworkAddress is the frame-relative coordinate abstraction that covers IPv4, IPv6, MAC, DNS, URL, port, and BGP-AS.
Brick Occupancy is a class for the current number of entities in a space; GMEOW Occupancy is a reified Measurement with location, scalar result, and provenance.
BOT Zone is a 3D spatial extent (physical or virtual); GMEOW Place is broader (includes outdoor, non-building geographic places), so the alignment is closeMatch rather than exact.

GMEOW Place is broader: it covers any geographic location, while LADM LA_SpatialUnit is specifically a spatial unit in a land-administration context. A Place typed as placeTypeParcel is the closest match.
Marine Regions Place is a geographic feature in the marine domain; GMEOW Place is the general geographic location superclass. Directional lossy projection.
CIDOC-CRM E41_Appellation is the time-spanned name; GMEOW PlaceNaming is the reified relator (NameUsage) that binds a PlaceName to a Place over an interval.
KnowRob FrameOfReference is a general spatial reference frame; GMEOW ReferenceFrame is the upper-ontology-grounded, realm-typed equivalent.
INSPIRE CadastralZoning is a specific kind of spatial regulatory overlay (cadastral hierarchy); GMEOW RegulatoryOverlay with overlayTypeZoning is the closest general match.
Marine Regions MaritimeBoundary is a maritime-specific regulatory boundary; GMEOW RegulatoryOverlay is the general time-scoped regulatory overlay. Directional lossy projection.

schema.org AdministrativeArea is a flat Place subclass for government-defined areas; GMEOW RegulatoryOverlay is a reified, time-scoped situation that binds a place, an authority, a regulation type, and optional deontic rules. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata Q1055894 is the general concept of an administrative territorial entity; GMEOW RegulatoryOverlay adds time-scoping, authority, regulation type, and deontic linkage.
GMEOW RightsStatement (deontic rules: permissions, prohibitions, duties) maps to LADM LA_RRR (rights, restrictions, responsibilities). Both are machine-readable statements of the rights situation.
FALDO Region models interval coordinates via begin/end; GMEOW SequenceCoordinates carries explicit start/end/strand and reference-assembly linkage.
Wikidata Q7187 is the prototypical sequence feature (gene); GMEOW SequenceFeature is the general class for any feature on a biological sequence.
SO sequence_feature is the root class for all sequence features; GMEOW SequenceFeatureType is the open value vocabulary of feature kinds.
GeoSPARQL SpatialObject is the broad top class for anything with spatial representation; GMEOW SpatialMeasurement is an observation relator, not a spatial object itself. Related match only.
SensorThings Datastream groups observations by sensor + observed property.
KnowRob RobotBaseTrajectory is a time-ordered path of robot base poses; GMEOW Trajectory is the generalised time-ordered path of LocationStates for any entity.
a Trajectory is a continuous spacetime volume (relatedMatch, not closeMatch — a trajectory is a path, not any arbitrary volume)
Trajectory as the continuous form of a stream; weaker alignment than Stream→Datastream.
Marine Regions isPartOf expresses administrative/mereological containment; GMEOW containedInPlace is the transitive geographic containment relation. Directional lossy projection.
Direct alignment: both gmeow:containsPlace and bot:containsZone represent parent→child containment.
coordinateResult points to a GeoCoordinates entity; geo:asWKT is a literal property on a Geometry. The projection layer bridges them via the CoordinateObservation path.
Wikidata P2506 is the geohash property; GMEOW geohash is the datatype property on a Geocode instance.
geometryResult points to a Geometry entity; geo:hasGeometry links a feature to its geometry. Related match because the subject roles differ (observation vs. feature).
Weak match: GMEOW hasCadastralReference links a Place to its cadastral identifier; INSPIRE referencePoint is a geometric point within the cadastral object. Different semantics.
schema.org maximumAttendeeCapacity is a flat integer property on Place/Event; GMEOW hasCapacity links to a reified Capacity Measurement. Directional lossy projection.
gmeow:hasCoordinateObservation links a place to its coordinate observation relator; geo:hasGeometry links a feature to its geometry. Directional lossy projection.
Marine Regions hasGeometry links a place to its geometry; aligned to GMEOW hasGeometry.
FALDO reference links a Position to its sequence; GMEOW inReferenceAssembly links SequenceCoordinates to a ReferenceFrame (the assembly).
Wikidata Q11155 is the BGP protocol; GMEOW networkAddressTypeBGP refers to the autonomous-system number used in BGP routing. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata Q8187 is the general port (computer networking) concept; GMEOW networkAddressTypePort refers to a transport-layer port number.

schema.org organizer is a loose match for the authority that imposed a regulatory overlay; GMEOW overlayAuthority is specifically the governing body (state, international organization, indigenous council) that decreed the regulation. Directional lossy projection.
schema.org legislation is a CreativeWork subclass for laws; GMEOW overlayRegulation links to a machine-readable RightsStatement (deontic rules). Directional lossy projection.
ICAO airway; AIXM route/airspace type aligned via Wikidata hub.

OWL-Time TimeZone is a temporal reference position; GMEOW overlayTypeCivilTimeZone adds the regulatory authority and time-scoped interval, treating the timezone as a government-decreed spatial overlay.
UNCLOS Article 33 contiguous zone; aligned to Wikidata.
UNCLOS Article 76 continental shelf; aligned to Wikidata.
ICAO control zone (CTR); AIXM airspace type aligned via Wikidata hub.
UNCLOS Article 55 defines the EEZ; GMEOW models it as a regulatory overlay with authority, time scope, and deontic rules. Maritime-specific depth bounds use overlayLowerBound / overlayUpperBound.
ICAO flight information region (FIR); AIXM airspace type aligned via Wikidata hub.
UNCLOS Article 86 high seas; aligned to Wikidata.
Marine protected area (IUCN / OSPAR); aligned to Wikidata protected area. Directional lossy: the Wikidata item is broader than marine-only.
Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) — temporary aeronautical information; aligned to Wikidata.
IUCN management categories (Ia–VI) are additional classifications on the protected area, not subclasses.
AIXM airspace types (prohibited, restricted, danger, TRA, TSA) are specific kinds of restricted airspace, aligned by reference in data via skos:exactMatch to the relevant AIXM code list values.
ICAO terminal control area (TMA/TCA); AIXM airspace type aligned via Wikidata hub.
UNCLOS Article 3 territorial sea; aligned to Wikidata.
ifcOWL is reference-only; GMEOW models the concept and links by IRI without copying axioms.
ifcOWL is reference-only; GMEOW models the concept and links by IRI without copying axioms.
A GMEOW Place with placeTypeParcel corresponds to an INSPIRE CadastralParcel — a single area of Earth surface under homogeneous real property rights.
ifcOWL is reference-only; GMEOW models the concept and links by IRI without copying axioms.
ifcOWL is reference-only; GMEOW models the concept and links by IRI without copying axioms.
Wikidata P3826 is the Open Location Code property; GMEOW plusCode is the datatype property on a Geocode instance.
schema.org:distance is a flat property with range QuantitativeValue or Text; GMEOW proximity is a reified Measurement with frame-declared metric kind. Directional lossy projection.
Wikidata Q1617265 is the general concept of linear referencing; GMEOW referenceFrameMileMarker is the frame for distance-along-a-line coordinates.
CORA Robot is the physical device; GMEOW referenceFrameRobotBase is the Cartesian coordinate frame anchored to that device. The alignment is structural, not identity.
CORA RoboticSystem is the system-level concept; GMEOW referenceFrameRobotBase is its spatial reference frame. Structural alignment only.
SOMA ArtificialAgent is the agent-level concept; GMEOW referenceFrameRobotBase is the spatial reference frame attached to that agent. Structural alignment only.

KnowRob Joint represents a single mechanical joint; GMEOW referenceFrameRobotCspace6DOF is the 6-dimensional configuration-space frame whose axes are joint angles. The alignment is compositional: a C-space frame is defined by its joints.

KnowRob SemanticEnvironmentMap is a robot-built map of the environment; GMEOW referenceFrameRobotSLAM is the reference frame in which such a map is expressed. The alignment is related because both are robot-centric spatial representations with probabilistic occupancy semantics, but a map and a reference frame are different ontological categories.
The literal value of a GMEOW CadastralReference directly corresponds to INSPIRE's nationalCadastralReference property value.
FALDO end is a property on a Region; GMEOW sequenceEnd is an explicit positiveInteger property on SequenceCoordinates.
FALDO begin is a property on a Region; GMEOW sequenceStart is an explicit positiveInteger property on SequenceCoordinates.
